name: The Home Depot, Inc.
summary: The Home Depot, Inc. operates as a leading retailer specializing in home improvement. Its namesake stores offer a comprehensive selection of products, including building materials, a wide range of home renovation supplies, lawn and garden essentials, decorative items, and goods for facilities maintenance, repair, and operations. Beyond its retail offerings, the company provides professional installation services for key household features such as flooring, cabinetry (including refacing options), countertops, heating and cooling systems, and windows. Customers can also access tool and equipment rental services. The Home Depot caters to a diverse clientele, primarily serving individual homeowners, alongside a variety of professional contractors, renovators, property managers, maintenance personnel, handymen, and specialized tradespeople like electricians and plumbers. Its products are also available through multiple online channels, including its flagship website, homedepot.com, as well as blinds.com for custom window treatments and thecompanystore.com for textiles and home décor. Headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, The Home Depot, Inc. was established in 1978. As of December 31, 2021, the company maintained a network of 2,317 retail locations throughout the United States.
